summary: Round 2. The L1 blocker on slide 6 is fixed, with ample clearance. But slide 3 has lost its required source footnote, so C1 now fails: an unannounced regression on a slide the author did not touch. The slide 6 move also left a trapped pocket and a rule that runs to nothing. None of the nine round-one majors were addressed. B1 passes. This is the last review round: the C1 blocker is a one-text-box fix and must land before delivery, and the open majors (well over the ship bar's 3) must be listed for the user.
